{"path":"/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_3/brief/silicon_melting_3_trial_4/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units           metal
timestep        1.0
atom_style      full

# Read data file
read_data       silicon.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate       3 3 3

# Define settings
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal

# NPT ensemble
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0

# Run the simulation
run             100000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix           1

# Compute MSD and diffusion
compute         msd all msd
variable        diff equal c_msd[4]/(6*step*dt)
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal v_diff
"}
